name: Nigeria
summary: A vertical tricolour of green, white and green. It was designed in 1958 by Michael Taiwo Akinkunmi, a 23-year-old student in London, and first raised at independence on 1 October 1960.
origin: Ahead of independence from Britain, a competition for a national flag drew nearly 3,000 entries. Michael Taiwo Akinkunmi, then studying in London, submitted green-white-green vertical stripes with a red sun with rays in the centre.
The judges removed the sun, and the plain tricolour was raised at midnight on 1 October 1960. Akinkunmi, often called 'Mr Flag Man', was honoured by the government before his death in 2023.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: Nigeria's forests and abundant natural wealth; agriculture.

history.label: Colony and Protectorate of Nigeria
history.note: Blue ensign with a green Star of David and crown badge.

facts: Akinkunmi's original design had a red sun in the white band, removed by the selection committee.
Nigeria's colonial badge featured a six-pointed star (Solomon's Seal) around a Tudor crown.
clues: Green, white and green vertical bands.
